mods.name: Arcana
mods.description: A mana system: crystals spawn underground, pylons recharge mana, wands cast spells. Add to any game, e.g. --mods=vanilla,arcana

mods.name: Base Blocks
mods.description: Common terrain and building blocks shared by other mods. Not a game on its own.

mods.name: Adventurers' Guild
mods.description: A JavaScript mod: quest boards, gold coins, a shop that sells other mods' items, gold ore, meteor showers and a guild leaderboard. Add to any game, e.g. --mods=vanilla,guild

mods.name: Industry
mods.description: Power networks: coal generators and solar panels feed cables, batteries, lamps and auto-miners. Add to any game, e.g. --mods=vanilla,industry

mods.name: One Block
mods.description: One block over the void. Break it and something else takes its place: dirt, then stone and ores, then creatures and crates. Build outwards from what you collect.

mods.name: Skyblock
mods.description: Survive on your own tiny island above the void. Mine the generator, complete challenges, expand.

mods.name: Vanilla Sandbox
mods.description: Endless generated terrain with mountains, oceans and forests. Creative building.
